observations.body: Heirs move from guardianship to adoption. But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all, So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ.

payload.posture: Read Galatians 4:1–7 as one movement in Paul's story, keeping the passage's actions, setting, sequence, and limits visible.
payload.tension: The passage states heirs move from guardianship to adoption. But I say that so long as the heir is a child, he is no different from a bondservant, though he is lord of all, So you are no longer a bondservant, but a son; and if a son, then an heir of God through Christ. It does not by itself supply every cause or later interpretation of this part of Paul's story.
